prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate where ten distinct entities populate the space. On the far left stands a woman in a blue coat holding a boarding pass. Beside the child, a brown dog wags its tail while looking up at its owner. The owner, a man in a red scarf, looks down at the dog with a gentle smile. To the right of the pair, an elderly lady in a floral dress sits on a metal bench clutching a small purse. Standing next to the bench is a flight attendant in a navy uniform checking her watch. Behind them, a teenager with pink hair leans against a luggage cart stacked with three suitcases. Near the check-in counter on the far right, a security guard in a black vest observes the crowd. Finally, a robotic cleaning bot moves slowly across the polished floor near the center. The woman in the blue coat is handing her ticket to the flight attendant who has stepped forward to inspect it. The child in the yellow raincoat is pointing at a plane visible through the glass. The man in the red scarf is looking at the brown dog affectionately. The elderly lady in the floral dress is sitting on the metal bench comfortably. There is no food or drink visible in anyone's hands. There is no digital advertising screen mounted on the walls.
